instruction: In the open Word document, add a header '深圳市行政区划' and then list these 4 Shenzhen districts below it: 福田区, 南山区, 宝安区, 龙岗区. Save the document when done.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter');

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Chrome, attempted to search for 24-hour self-service visa check-in machine addresses in Futian District via Google (SSL error), sz.gov.cn, Baidu (irrelevant results for '24'), and visaforchina.cn (blocked by captcha). Never found the addresses and never wrote anything in the Word document. Hit 50-turn limit.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome and navigate to URLs, type in address bars and search bars, switch between browser tabs, interact with Chinese government websites (sz.gov.cn), navigate to Baidu. Can interact with LibreOffice Writer window.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because: (1) Google had SSL certificate error, (2) could not formulate effective search queries to find specific visa machine locations, (3) visaforchina.cn blocked with captcha, (4) never returned to Writer to type any content.
metadata.task_rationale: Medium difficulty decomposition: combines writing a header and a list of 4 items into the Word document. Tests structured content creation in Writer with more items than variation 1. Uses partial credit scoring for each component.
metadata.explanation: Task asks model to write a header and 4 district names in the docx. Custom getter reads all text from docx. Custom metric awards 0.3 for header presence and 0.175 per district name found (0.7 total for all 4 items). Partial credit ensures any progress is rewarded.

scoring_breakdown.header: 0.30 - Header '深圳市行政区划' found in document

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts docx text content by downloading file from VM and parsing with python-docx, returning both full text and individual paragraphs.
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter fields directly (expected.get('expected_header'), expected.get('expected_items')) — consistent with get_rule returning rules dict.
Partial credit scoring is well-designed: 0.3 for header + 0.175 per district (4 items = 0.7), totaling 1.0.
Fuzzy matching fallback with rapidfuzz at 0.8 threshold provides robustness against minor text variations.
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S + Enter for overwrite confirmation) before getter reads the file.
All instruction requirements are covered: header presence, 4 district names, and document saving (via postconfig).

Minor gap: instruction says 'header' implying heading formatting style, but evaluator only checks text presence, not whether it was formatted as a heading in the docx structure. This is a reasonable simplification for practical verification.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider optionally checking if the header text uses a heading style (e.g., doc.paragraphs[i].style.name starts with 'Heading') for stricter verification of 'header' formatting, though text presence is acceptable.
